transcript.t: Ann, look through my new telescope.
Wow! I can see craters on the Moon.
Yes, and tonight Mars is also visible. It looks like a small red dot.
The soil on Mars contains a lot of iron, so it looks reddish.
Has any human being set foot on Mars?
No. Only robots, like rovers, have been there. People have walked on the Moon, though.
Maybe one day it will be our generation.
